| CN-TFF | Integrated flight deck | Garmin | G1000 NXi |  |  | 2017 | Factory installed. |

| Registration | Part | Part number | Serial number | Installed (date) | Airframe hours at installation | Limit | Source of limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CN-TFA | Engine oil pressure switch | 83278 |  | 2024-02-14 | 7210.4 | 3,000 h | AD 2013-11-11 |
| CN-TFB | Engine oil pressure switch | 83278 |  | 2023-05-09 | 5880 | 3,000 h | AD 2013-11-11 |
| CN-TFC | Engine oil pressure switch | 83278 |  | 2022-11-21 | 3350.7 | 3,000 h | Procedures manual 3.2 |

Source: WO-2025-0095, section 
Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11.

Removed switch P/N 83278 at 2,951.3 hours since installation.

Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-037.

Source: WO-SCAN, section 
Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11 paragraph (g)(6).

Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. AD compliance record updated. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-022.

Performed by: S. Idrissi

Approved for return to service: A. Tazi

Figure description: The figure shows a simple oval outline containing the word "QUALITY" in the center. There are no labels, values, units, part numbers, or notes printed in it.

Source: TRAIN-AD, section 4
The engine oil pressure switch
P/N 83278, 3,000 hours Replace with a new, zero-time switch Record part number, date, and airframe hours
Speaker notes: The 50-hour allowance in paragraph (g)(6) of AD 2013-11-11 applied once, to switches that were already at or near the limit when the directive took effect on 1 August 2013. It is not a grace period you can use today. Our manual, section 3.2, applies the same 3,000-hour limit to every 172R and 172S we maintain.

However, the current total airframe hours for CN‑TFE are not listed anywhere in the supplied documents.
- The **Time‑controlled parts** sheet does not include an entry for CN‑TFE.
- The work orders (**WO‑2025‑0095**, **WO‑SCAN**) describe oil pressure switch replacements but do not specify the aircraft registration.
- **TRAIN‑AD** only states the general 3,000‑hour replacement requirement.

Without the current airframe hours, the hours since the last installation (2025‑03‑03 at 9,940.2) cannot be calculated, and compliance with the 3,000‑hour limit cannot be assessed.
